shots.title: The sky changes
shots.action: Luma and Pip approach the forest archway; fireflies dim; Luma: 'Something in the forest is changing.'

shots.title: Fireflies go out
shots.action: All fireflies disappear. Luma shields Pip; Pip: 'Every light stopped.'

shots.title: The floating golden lantern
shots.action: A small mysterious glowing lantern floats between the roots. Luma: 'Pip, look at that lantern.'

shots.title: Three symbols appear
shots.action: The lantern shows a star, a tree and two paw prints. Pip: 'Two paw prints. Like ours.'

shots.title: A choice made together
shots.action: Pip joins Luma and they follow the floating light carefully. Luma: 'This time, I will listen to you.'

shots.title: Entrance to the hidden glade
shots.action: Roots part and reveal a flower-filled glade. Pip: 'How has this place been here all along?'

shots.title: Tiny bell under the leaf
shots.action: Luma notices a small silver moth under a leaf. Luma: 'You're not alone.'

shots.title: The moth shows a clue
shots.action: Golden dust traces a glowing tree and a door. Pip: 'It's showing us a way.'
